      <div class="sr" id="stat.169.861"><b>169.861</b> [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1982/0/617/#laws.0.27.0">1982 c 617 s 27</a>]</div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.169.862">
        <h1 class="shn">169.862 PERMIT FOR BALED FARM PRODUCT TO EXCEED HEIGHT OR WIDTH.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.862.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Annual permit authority; restrictions.</span></h2>
          <p class="in"> The commissioner of transportation with respect to highways under the commissioner's jurisdiction, and local authorities with respect to highways under their jurisdiction, may issue an annual permit to enable a vehicle carrying bales of hay, straw, or cornstalks, with a total outside width of the vehicle or the load not exceeding 12 feet, and a total height of the loaded vehicle not exceeding 15 feet, to be operated on public streets and highways. Loaded vehicles operating on interstate highways within the seven-county metropolitan area may not exceed a total height of 14-1/2 feet.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.862.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Additional restrictions.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">Permits issued under this section are governed by the applicable provisions of section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.86">169.86</a> except as otherwise provided herein and, in addition, carry the following restrictions:</p>
          <p class="in">(a) The vehicles may not be operated between sunset and sunrise, when visibility is impaired by weather, fog, or other conditions rendering persons and vehicles not clearly visible at a distance of 500 feet, or on Sunday from noon until sunset, or on the days the following holidays are observed: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day.</p>
          <p class="in">(b) The vehicles may not be operated on a trunk highway with a pavement less than 24 feet wide.</p>
          <p class="in">(c) A vehicle operated under the permit must be equipped with a retractable or removable mirror on the left side so located that it will reflect to the driver a clear view of the highway for a distance of at least 200 feet to the rear of the vehicle.</p>
          <p class="in">(d) A vehicle operated under the permit must display red, orange, or yellow flags, 18 inches square, as markers at the front and rear and on both sides of the load. The load must be securely bound to the transporting vehicle.</p>
          <p class="in">(e) Farm vehicles not for hire carrying baled hay, straw, or cornstalks less than 20 miles are exempt from the requirement to obtain a permit. All other requirements of this section apply to vehicles transporting baled hay, straw, or cornstalks.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.169.862.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1979/0/44/#laws.0.1.0">1979 c 44 s 1</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1983/0/198/#laws.0.12.0">1983 c 198 s 12</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1983/0/293/#laws.0.68.0">1983 c 293 s 68</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1985/0/299/#laws.0.11.0">1985 c 299 s 11</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1986/0/398/#laws.13.13.0">1986 c 398 art 13 s 13</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1995/0/174/#laws.0.2.0">1995 c 174 s 2</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1996/0/455/#laws.3.22.0">1996 c 455 art 3 s 22</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2008/0/287/#laws.1.59.0">2008 c 287 art 1 s 59</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2009/0/64/#laws.0.10.0">2009 c 64 s 10</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2010/0/320/#laws.1.8.0">2010 c 320 art 1 s 8</a>,9</p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.169.863">
        <h1 class="shn">169.863 SPECIAL PULPWOOD VEHICLE PERMIT.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.863.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Special vehicle.</span></h2>
          <p>The commissioner may issue a permit for a vehicle that meets the following requirements:</p>
          <p>(a) There must be no more than two support points for the vehicle or for each vehicle of a vehicle combination. The support point of each axle group must be capable of distributing the load equally to each axle of the group with a variance of no more than 3,000 pounds between any two axles of the group.</p>
          <p>(b) The maximum wheel load may not exceed the tire manufacturer's recommended load or the following weight limits, whichever is less:</p>
          <p>(1) front steering axles, 550 pounds per inch;</p>
          <p>(2) other single axles, 500 pounds per inch;</p>
          <p>(3) tandem axles, 450 pounds per inch; and</p>
          <p>(4) tridem or quad axle groups, 425 pounds per inch.</p>
          <p>(c) The axle group weights must comply with the limitations of section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.824">169.824</a>.</p>
          <p>(d) The vehicle may not be equipped with a variable load axle, unless the variable load axle cannot be operated from the cab of the vehicle.</p>
          <p>(e) The vehicle transports pole-length pulpwood, carries a gross vehicle weight of not more than 82,000 pounds, and has six or more axles.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.863.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Permit restrictions.</span></h2>
          <p>A vehicle operating under a permit issued under this section may not travel on an interstate highway. The permit does not authorize the vehicle to exceed allowable gross weights that restrict travel on a highway or bridge under the authority of the commissioner or a local road authority.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.863.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">Expiration date.</span></h2>
          <p>Upon request of the permit applicant, the expiration date for a permit issued under this section must be the same as the expiration date of the permitted vehicle's registration.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.169.863.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/1989/0/299/#laws.0.2.0">1989 c 299 s 2</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2010/0/320/#laws.1.10.0">2010 c 320 art 1 s 10</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/312/#laws.11.13.0">2014 c 312 art 11 s 13</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.169.864">
        <h1 class="shn">169.864 SPECIAL PRODUCTS VEHICLE PERMITS.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.864.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Special three-unit vehicle permit.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">The commissioner may issue a permit for a vehicle that transports paper products, finished forest products, or iron ore tailings and meets the following requirements:</p>
          <p class="in">(1) is a combination of vehicles, including a truck-tractor and a semitrailer drawing one additional semitrailer, which may be equipped with an auxiliary dolly, and no semitrailer used in the three-vehicle combination has an overall length in excess of 28-1/2 feet;</p>
          <p class="in">(2) has a maximum gross vehicle weight of 108,000 pounds;</p>
          <p class="in">(3) complies with the axle weight limits in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.824">169.824</a>;</p>
          <p class="in">(4) complies with the tire weight limits in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.823">169.823</a> or the tire manufacturer's recommended load, whichever is less;</p>
          <p class="in">(5) is operated only in this state on Trunk Highway marked 2 between Grand Rapids and the port of Duluth; on Trunk Highway marked 169 between Grand Rapids and its junction with Trunk Highway marked 53; on Trunk Highway marked 194 between Trunk Highway marked 2 and Trunk Highway marked 53; and on Trunk Highway marked 53; and</p>
          <p class="in">(6) the seasonal weight increases authorized under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.826#stat.169.826.1">169.826, subdivision 1</a>, do not apply.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.864.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Special two-unit vehicle permit.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">The commissioner may issue a permit for a vehicle that transports paper products, finished forest products, or iron ore tailings and meets the following requirements:</p>
          <p class="in">(1) is a combination of vehicles consisting of a truck-tractor and a single semitrailer that may exceed 48 feet, but not 53 feet, if the distance from the kingpin to the centerline of the rear axle group of the semitrailer does not exceed 43 feet;</p>
          <p class="in">(2) has a maximum gross vehicle weight of 90,000 pounds if the vehicle combination has a total of six or more axles or 97,000 pounds if the vehicle combination has a total of seven or more axles;</p>
          <p class="in">(3) has a maximum gross vehicle weight of 99,000 pounds during the time when seasonal weight increases authorized under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.826#stat.169.826.1">169.826, subdivision 1</a>, are in effect;</p>
          <p class="in">(4) complies with the axle weight limits in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.824">169.824</a>;</p>
          <p class="in">(5) complies with the tire weight limits in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.823">169.823</a> or the tire manufacturer's recommended load, whichever is less; and</p>
          <p class="in">(6) is operated only on the highways specified in subdivision 1, clause (5).</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.864.2a">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2a.<span class="headnote">Special tire-hauling permit.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) The commissioner may issue a permit authorizing a vehicle used exclusively to haul earthmover tires, if the vehicle:</p>
          <p>(1) is a combination of vehicles with seven or more axles, consisting of a truck with loader and trailer, which may be equipped with an auxiliary dolly;</p>
          <p>(2) has a maximum gross vehicle weight of 108,000 pounds;</p>
          <p>(3) has a maximum width of 144 inches;</p>
          <p>(4) does not exceed the axle weight limits in sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.823#stat.169.823.1">169.823, subdivision 1</a>, clause (2), and <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.824">169.824</a>, by more than 22 percent;</p>
          <p>(5) complies with the tire weight limits in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.823">169.823</a>, or the tire manufacturer's recommended load, whichever is less; and</p>
          <p>(6) is operated only on the highways specified in subdivision 1, clause (5).</p>
          <p>(b) The seasonal weight increases authorized under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.826#stat.169.826.1">169.826, subdivision 1</a>, do not apply to permits issued under this subdivision.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.864.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">Restrictions.</span></h2>
          <p>Vehicles issued permits under subdivisions 1, 2, and 2a, must comply with the following restrictions:</p>
          <p>(1) the vehicle must be operated in compliance with seasonal load restrictions under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.87">169.87</a>;</p>
          <p>(2) the vehicle may not be operated on the interstate highway system; and</p>
          <p>(3) the vehicle may be operated on streets or highways under the control of local authorities only upon the approval of the local authority; however, vehicles may have reasonable access to terminals and facilities for food, fuel, repairs, and rest and for continuity of route within one mile of the national network as provided by section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.81#stat.169.81.3">169.81, subdivision 3</a>, and by Code of Federal Regulations, title 23, section 658.19.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.864.4">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4.<span class="headnote">Permit fee; appropriation.</span></h2>
          <p>Vehicle permits issued under subdivision 1, clause (1), must be annual permits. The fee is $850 for each vehicle combination and must be deposited in the trunk highway fund. The fee for annual permits issued under subdivision 2 is $300 for a 90,000-pound vehicle combination or $500 for a 97,000-pound vehicle combination. The fee for annual permits issued under subdivision 2a is $850. An amount sufficient to administer the permit program is appropriated from the trunk highway fund to the commissioner for the costs of administering the permit program.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.169.864.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2005/1/1/#laws.4.39.0">1Sp2005 c 1 art 4 s 39</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2008/0/287/#laws.1.60.0">2008 c 287 art 1 s 60</a>,61,113; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2008/0/370/#laws.0.16.0">2008 c 370 s 16</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2009/0/64/#laws.0.11.0">2009 c 64 s 11</a>,12; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2010/0/320/#laws.1.11.0">2010 c 320 art 1 s 11</a>,12; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2017/1/3/#laws.3.68.0">1Sp2017 c 3 art 3 s 68</a>-70; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2019/1/3/#laws.3.66.0">1Sp2019 c 3 art 3 s 66</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.169.865">
        <h1 class="shn">169.865 SPECIAL FARM PRODUCTS PERMITS.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.865.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.</h2>
          <p>[Renumbered subd 1b]</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.865.1a">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 1a.<span class="headnote">Definition.</span></h2>
          <p>For purposes of this section, "qualifying agricultural products" means:</p>
          <p>(1) agricultural crops, including but not limited to corn, soybeans, oats, grain, and by-products of agricultural crops;</p>
          <p>(2) livestock, including but not limited to cattle, hogs, and poultry;</p>
          <p>(3) food crops, including but not limited to sugar beets, potatoes, carrots, and onions;</p>
          <p>(4) fluid milk;</p>
          <p>(5) seed and material used for or in livestock and poultry feed;</p>
          <p>(6) livestock manure; and</p>
          <p>(7) raw or processed grass seed.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.865.1b">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 1b.<span class="headnote">Six-axle vehicles.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">(a) A road authority may issue an annual permit authorizing a vehicle or combination of vehicles with a total of six or more axles to haul qualifying agricultural products and be operated with a gross vehicle weight of up to:</p>
          <p class="in">(1) 90,000 pounds; and</p>
          <p class="in">(2) 99,000 pounds during the period set by the commissioner under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.826#stat.169.826.1">169.826, subdivision 1</a>.</p>
          <p class="in">(b) Notwithstanding subdivision 3, paragraph (a), clause (4), a vehicle or combination of vehicles operated under this subdivision and transporting only sealed intermodal containers may be operated on an interstate highway if allowed by the United States Department of Transportation.</p>
          <p class="in">(c) The fee for a permit issued under this subdivision is $300, or a proportional amount as provided in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.86#stat.169.86.5">169.86, subdivision 5</a>.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.865.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Seven-axle vehicles.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">(a) A road authority may issue an annual permit authorizing a vehicle or combination of vehicles with a total of seven or more axles to haul qualifying agricultural products and be operated with a gross weight of up to:</p>
          <p class="in">(1) 97,000 pounds; and</p>
          <p class="in">(2) 99,000 pounds during the period set by the commissioner under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.826#stat.169.826.1">169.826, subdivision 1</a>.</p>
          <p class="in">(b) Drivers of vehicles operating under this subdivision must comply with driver qualification requirements adopted under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/221.0314">221.0314, subdivisions 2</a> to 5, and Code of Federal Regulations, title 49, parts 40 and 382, unless exempt under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/221.031">221.031</a>, subdivision 2c.</p>
          <p class="in">(c) The fee for a permit issued under this subdivision is $500, or a proportional amount as provided in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.86#stat.169.86.5">169.86, subdivision 5</a>.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.865.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">Requirements; restrictions.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">(a) A vehicle or combination of vehicles operating under this section:</p>
          <p class="in">(1) is subject to axle weight limitations under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.824#stat.169.824.1">169.824, subdivision 1</a>;</p>
          <p class="in">(2) is subject to seasonal load restrictions under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.87">169.87</a>;</p>
          <p class="in">(3) is subject to bridge load limits posted under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.84">169.84</a>;</p>
          <p class="in">(4) may only be operated on paved streets and highways other than interstate highways;</p>
          <p class="in">(5) may not be operated with loads that exceed the manufacturer's gross vehicle weight rating as affixed to the vehicle, or other certification of gross vehicle weight rating complying with Code of Federal Regulations, title 49, sections 567.4 to 567.7;</p>
          <p class="in">(6) must be issued a permit from each road authority having jurisdiction over a road on which the vehicle is operated, if required;</p>
          <p class="in">(7) must comply with the requirements of section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.851#stat.169.851.4">169.851, subdivision 4</a>; and</p>
          <p class="in">(8) must have brakes on all wheels.</p>
          <p class="in">(b) The percentage allowances for exceeding gross weights if transporting unfinished forest products under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/168.013#stat.168.013.3">168.013, subdivision 3</a>, paragraph (b), or for the first haul of unprocessed or raw farm products or unfinished forest products under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/168.013#stat.168.013.3">168.013, subdivision 3</a>, paragraph (d), clause (3), do not apply to a vehicle or combination of vehicles operated under this section.</p>
          <p>(c) Notwithstanding paragraph (a), clause (4), a vehicle or combination of vehicles hauling fluid milk under a permit issued by the commissioner of transportation may also operate on interstate highways as provided under United States Code, title 23, section 127.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.865.4">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4.<span class="headnote">Deposit of revenues.</span></h2>
          <p class="in"> Revenue from the permits issued by the commissioner under this section must be deposited in the bridge inspection and signing account as provided under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.86#stat.169.86.5b">169.86, subdivision 5b</a>.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.865.5">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 5.<span class="headnote">Expiration date.</span></h2>
          <p>Upon request of the permit applicant, the expiration date for a permit issued under this section must be the same as the expiration date of the permitted vehicle's registration.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.169.865.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2008/0/287/#laws.1.62.0">2008 c 287 art 1 s 62</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2008/0/370/#laws.0.9.0">2008 c 370 s 9</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2009/0/64/#laws.0.13.0">2009 c 64 s 13</a>-16; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2010/0/320/#laws.1.13.0">2010 c 320 art 1 s 13</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2010/0/351/#laws.0.34.0">2010 c 351 s 34</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2010/0/382/#laws.0.41.0">2010 c 382 s 41</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2012/0/287/#laws.3.37.0">2012 c 287 art 3 s 37</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/287/#laws.0.15.0">2014 c 287 s 15</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/312/#laws.11.14.0">2014 c 312 art 11 s 14</a>-16; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2017/1/3/#laws.3.71.0">1Sp2017 c 3 art 3 s 71</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2019/1/3/#laws.3.67.0">1Sp2019 c 3 art 3 s 67</a>-69,139; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2023/0/68/#laws.4.54.0">2023 c 68 art 4 s 54</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.169.8655">
        <h1 class="shn">169.8655 SPECIAL SUGAR BEET HAULING VEHICLE PERMIT.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.8655.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">122,000-pound vehicles; East Grand Forks.</span></h2>
          <p>A road authority may issue a permit for a vehicle or combination of vehicles that transports sugar beets and meets the following requirements:</p>
          <p>(1) does not exceed a maximum gross vehicle weight of 122,000 pounds;</p>
          <p>(2) does not use a semitrailer in a combination of vehicles that has an overall length in excess of 28-1/2 feet; and</p>
          <p>(3) is only for operation on the following roads in East Grand Forks:</p>
          <p>(i) U.S. Highway 2 between the North Dakota border and Fifth Avenue Northeast;</p>
          <p>(ii) Fifth Avenue Northeast between U.S. Highway 2 and Business Highway 2; and</p>
          <p>(iii) Business Highway 2 from Fifth Avenue Northeast to the sugar beet processing facility on Business Highway 2.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.8655.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Requirements; restrictions.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) A vehicle or combination of vehicles issued a permit under subdivision 1:</p>
          <p>(1) is subject to axle weight limitations under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.824#stat.169.824.1">169.824, subdivision 1</a>;</p>
          <p>(2) is subject to seasonal load restrictions under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.87">169.87</a>;</p>
          <p>(3) is subject to bridge load limits posted under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.84">169.84</a>;</p>
          <p>(4) may not be operated with a load that exceeds the tire manufacturer's recommended load limit under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.823">169.823</a>, the manufacturer's gross vehicle weight rating as affixed to the vehicle, or other certification of gross weight rating under Code of Federal Regulations, title 49, sections 567.4 to 567.7; and</p>
          <p>(5) may not be operated on the interstate highway system.</p>
          <p>(b) The seasonal weight increases authorized under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.826">169.826</a> do not apply to a vehicle or combination of vehicles operating under this section.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.8655.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">Permit fee.</span></h2>
          <p>A permit issued under this section must be an annual permit. A permit issued under this section may only be issued before July 1, 2027. The fee for permits issued under this section is $300 and must be deposited in the trunk highway fund.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.169.8655.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first">
          <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2024/0/104/#laws.1.49.0">2024 c 104 art 1 s 49</a>
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.169.866">
        <h1 class="shn">169.866 SPECIAL CANOLA-HAULING VEHICLE PERMIT.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.866.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Special three-unit vehicle permit.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">The commissioner may issue a permit for a vehicle that meets the following requirements:</p>
          <p class="in">(1) is a combination of vehicles, including a truck-tractor and a semitrailer drawing one additional trailer or semitrailer, and no semitrailer used in the three-vehicle combination has an overall length in excess of 28-1/2 feet;</p>
          <p class="in">(2) has a maximum gross vehicle weight of 105,500 pounds;</p>
          <p class="in">(3) complies with the axle weight limits in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.824">169.824</a>;</p>
          <p class="in">(4) complies with the tire weight limits in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.823">169.823</a>, or the tire manufacturers' recommended load, whichever is less;</p>
          <p class="in">(5) is operated only in this state on marked Trunk Highway 175 from Hallock to the North Dakota border, on U.S. Highway 75 from Hallock to Donaldson, and on marked Trunk Highway 11 from Donaldson to the North Dakota border; and</p>
          <p class="in">(6) the seasonal weight increases authorized under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.826#stat.169.826.1">169.826, subdivision 1</a>, do not apply.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.866.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Restrictions.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">Vehicles issued permits under subdivision 1 must comply with the following restrictions:</p>
          <p class="in">(1) the vehicle must be operated in compliance with seasonal load restrictions under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.87">169.87</a>;</p>
          <p class="in">(2) the vehicle may not be operated on the interstate highway system or national network highways; and</p>
          <p class="in">(3) the vehicle may be operated on streets or highways under the control of local authorities only upon the approval of the local authority; however, vehicles may have reasonable access to terminals and facilities for food, fuel, repairs, and rest, and for continuity of route within one mile of the national network as provided by section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.81">169.81</a>, subdivision 3, and by the Code of Federal Regulations, title 23, section 658.19.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.866.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">Permit fee; appropriation.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">Vehicle permits issued under subdivision 1 must be annual permits. The fee is $850 for each vehicle, or a proportional amount as provided in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.86#stat.169.86.5">169.86, subdivision 5</a>, and must be deposited in the trunk highway fund. An amount sufficient to administer the permit program is appropriated from the trunk highway fund to the commissioner for the costs of administering the permit program.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.866.4">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4.<span class="headnote">Expiration date.</span></h2>
          <p>Upon request of the permit applicant, the expiration date for a permit issued under this section must be the same as the expiration date of the permitted vehicle's registration.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.169.866.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2008/0/350/#laws.1.50.0">2008 c 350 art 1 s 50</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2009/0/64/#laws.0.17.0">2009 c 64 s 17</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/312/#laws.11.17.0">2014 c 312 art 11 s 17</a>,18</p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.169.8665">
        <h1 class="shn">169.8665 SPECIAL SOYBEAN MEAL-HAULING VEHICLE PERMIT.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.8665.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Special three-unit vehicle permit.</span></h2>
          <p>The commissioner may issue a permit for a vehicle that transports soybean meal and meets the following requirements:</p>
          <p>(1) is a combination of vehicles, including a truck-tractor and a semitrailer drawing one additional semitrailer, and no semitrailer used in the three-vehicle combination has an overall length in excess of 28-1/2 feet;</p>
          <p>(2) does not exceed a maximum gross vehicle weight of 106,000 pounds; and</p>
          <p>(3) is operated only in this state on marked U.S. Highway 75 in Crookston to marked U.S. Highway 2, and on marked U.S. Highway 2 from Crookston to the North Dakota border.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.8665.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Special two-unit vehicle permit.</span></h2>
          <p>The commissioner may issue a permit for a vehicle that transports soybean meal and meets the following requirements:</p>
          <p>(1) is a combination of vehicles consisting of a truck-tractor and a single semitrailer that may exceed 48 feet, but not 53 feet, if the distance from the kingpin to the centerline of the rear axle group of the semitrailer does not exceed 43 feet;</p>
          <p>(2) does not exceed a maximum gross vehicle weight of 106,000 pounds; and</p>
          <p>(3) is operated only on the highways specified in subdivision 1, clause (3).</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.8665.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">Restrictions.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) A vehicle issued a permit under subdivision 1 or 2:</p>
          <p>(1) is subject to the axle weight limits in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.824">169.824</a>;</p>
          <p>(2) is subject to bridge load limits posted pursuant to section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.84">169.84</a>;</p>
          <p>(3) is subject to seasonal load restrictions under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.87">169.87</a>;</p>
          <p>(4) may not be operated with a load that exceeds the tire manufacturer's recommended load under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.823">169.823</a>, the manufacturer's gross vehicle weight rating as affixed to the vehicle, or other certification of gross weight rating under Code of Federal Regulations, title 49, sections 567.4 to 567.7;</p>
          <p>(5) may not be operated on the interstate highway system; and</p>
          <p>(6) may be operated on streets or highways under the control of a local authority only upon the approval of the local authority. However, vehicles may have reasonable access to terminals and facilities for food, fuel, repairs, and rest, and for continuity of route within one mile of the national network as provided by section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.81#stat.169.81.3">169.81, subdivision 3</a>, and Code of Federal Regulations, title 23, section 658.19.</p>
          <p>(b) The seasonal weight increases authorized under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.826">169.826</a> do not apply to permits issued under this section.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.8665.4">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4.<span class="headnote">Permit fee; appropriation.</span></h2>
          <p>Vehicle permits issued under subdivision 1 must be annual permits. The fee is $850 for each vehicle, or a proportional amount as provided in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.86#stat.169.86.5">169.86, subdivision 5</a>, and must be deposited in the trunk highway fund. An amount sufficient to administer the permit program is appropriated from the trunk highway fund to the commissioner for the costs of administering the permit program.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.8665.5">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 5.<span class="headnote">Expiration date.</span></h2>
          <p>Upon request of the permit applicant, the expiration date for a permit issued under this section must be the same as the expiration date of the permitted vehicle's registration.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.169.8665.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first"><a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2021/1/5/#laws.4.66.0">1Sp2021 c 5 art 4 s 66</a>; <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2022/0/55/#laws.1.76.0">2022 c 55 art 1 s 76</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="sr" id="stat.169.867"><b>169.867</b> [Repealed, <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2014/0/227/#laws.1.23.0">2014 c 227 art 1 s 23</a>]</div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.169.868">
        <h1 class="shn">169.868 SPECIAL FREIGHT DISTRIBUTION PERMIT.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.868.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Six-axle vehicles.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) A road authority may issue an annual permit for a vehicle or combination of vehicles with a combination of six or more axles to haul freight and to be operated with a gross vehicle weight up to:</p>
          <p>(1) 90,000 pounds; and</p>
          <p>(2) 99,000 pounds during the period set by the commissioner under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.826">169.826</a>, subdivision 1.</p>
          <p>(b) The fee for a permit issued under this subdivision is $300.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.868.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Seven-axle vehicles.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) A road authority may issue an annual permit for a vehicle or combination of vehicles with a combination of seven or more axles to haul freight and to be operated with a gross vehicle weight up to:</p>
          <p>(1) 97,000 pounds; and</p>
          <p>(2) 99,000 pounds during the period set by the commissioner under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.826">169.826</a>, subdivision 1.</p>
          <p>(b) The fee for a permit issued under this subdivision is $500.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.868.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">Restrictions.</span></h2>
          <p>Vehicles issued permits under this section must comply with all requirements and restrictions in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.865#stat.169.865.3">169.865, subdivision 3</a>. A vehicle may be operated under a permit issued under this section only to haul freight to or from a distribution facility that is:</p>
          <p>(1) constructed on or after July 1, 2013; and</p>
          <p>(2) located within the Department of Transportation District 4.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.868.4">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4.<span class="headnote">Deposit of revenues.</span></h2>
          <p>Revenue from the permits issued by the commissioner under this section must be deposited in the bridge inspection and signing account as provided under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.86#stat.169.86.5b">169.86, subdivision 5b</a>.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.169.868.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first">
          <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2013/0/140/#laws.0.1.0">2013 c 140 s 1</a>
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.169.869">
        <h1 class="shn">169.869 ROAD CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS SPECIAL PERMIT.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.869.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Definition.</span></h2>
          <p>For purposes of this section, "road construction materials" means street or highway construction materials, including but not limited to aggregate material as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/298.75#stat.298.75.1">298.75, subdivision 1</a>, paragraph (a), hot mix asphalt, plastic concrete, cementitious materials, concrete admixtures, asphalt cement, and recycled road materials.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.869.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Six-axle vehicles.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) A road authority may issue an annual permit authorizing a vehicle or combination of vehicles with a total of six or more axles to haul road construction materials and be operated with a gross vehicle weight of up to:</p>
          <p>(1) 90,000 pounds; and</p>
          <p>(2) 99,000 pounds during the period set by the commissioner under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.826">169.826</a>, subdivision 1.</p>
          <p>(b) The fee for a permit issued under this subdivision is $300, or a proportional amount as provided in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.86#stat.169.86.5">169.86, subdivision 5</a>.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.869.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">Seven-axle vehicles.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) A road authority may issue an annual permit authorizing a vehicle or combination of vehicles with a total of seven or more axles to haul road construction materials and be operated with a gross vehicle weight of up to:</p>
          <p>(1) 97,000 pounds; and</p>
          <p>(2) 99,000 pounds during the period set by the commissioner under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.826">169.826</a>, subdivision 1.</p>
          <p>(b) The fee for a permit issued under this subdivision is $500, or a proportional amount as provided in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.86#stat.169.86.5">169.86, subdivision 5</a>.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.869.4">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4.<span class="headnote">Authority; restrictions.</span></h2>
          <p>A vehicle or combination of vehicles operating under this section:</p>
          <p>(1) may only be operated on paved or unpaved streets and highways, other than interstate highways;</p>
          <p>(2) must comply with the requirements and restrictions in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.865">169.865, subdivision </a>3, paragraph (a), clauses (1) to (3), (5), (7), and (8); and</p>
          <p>(3) must be operated in compliance with truck route requirements and vehicle weight restrictions, as established under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.87#stat.169.87.1">169.87, subdivision 1</a>, by a local road authority or the commissioner.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.869.5">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 5.<span class="headnote">Revenues.</span></h2>
          <p>Revenue from the permits issued by the commissioner under this section must be deposited in the bridge inspection and signing account under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.86">169.86</a>, subdivision 5b.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.869.6">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 6.<span class="headnote">Expiration date.</span></h2>
          <p>Upon request of the permit applicant, the expiration date for a permit issued under this section must be the same as the expiration date of the permitted vehicle's registration.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.869.7">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 7.<span class="headnote">Permit information.</span></h2>
          <p>The commissioner must make information available to local road authorities on an Internet website that identifies permit issuances under this section and the counties in which a vehicle with a permit is intended to be operated.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.869.8">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 8.<span class="headnote">Local preferred routes.</span></h2>
          <p>A local road authority may identify local preferred routes for operating a vehicle on local streets and highways under a permit issued in this section. A holder of a permit issued in this section and any person seeking to apply for a permit are encouraged to:</p>
          <p>(1) upon request of a local road authority, provide comment on identification of preferred routes; and</p>
          <p>(2) make reasonable efforts to operate a vehicle on the preferred routes when operating under the permit.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.169.869.history
			">
        <h2>History: </h2>
        <p class="first">
          <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/laws/2017/1/3/#laws.3.72.0">1Sp2017 c 3 art 3 s 72</a>
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="stat.169.87">
        <h1 class="shn">169.87 SEASONAL LOAD RESTRICTION; ROUTE DESIGNATION.</h1>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.87.1">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subdivision 1.<span class="headnote">Optional power.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) Local authorities, with respect to highways under their jurisdiction, may prohibit the operation of vehicles upon any such highway or impose restrictions as to the weight of vehicles to be operated upon any such highway, whenever any such highway, by reason of deterioration, rain, snow, or other climatic conditions, will be seriously damaged or destroyed unless the use of vehicles thereon is prohibited or the permissible weights thereof reduced.</p>
          <p>(b) The local authority enacting any such prohibition or restriction shall erect or cause to be erected and maintained signs plainly indicating the prohibition or restriction at each end of that portion of any highway affected thereby, and the prohibition or restriction shall not be effective unless and until such signs are erected and maintained.</p>
          <p>(c) Municipalities, with respect to highways under their jurisdiction, may also, by ordinance, prohibit the operation of trucks or other commercial vehicles, or may impose limitations as to the weight thereof, on designated highways, which prohibitions and limitations shall be designated by appropriate signs placed on such highways.</p>
          <p>(d) The commissioner shall likewise have authority, as hereinabove granted to local authorities, to determine and to impose prohibitions or restrictions as to the weight of vehicles operated upon any highway under the jurisdiction of the commissioner, and such restrictions shall be effective when signs giving notice thereof are erected upon the highway or portion of any highway affected by such action.</p>
          <p>(e) When a local authority petitions the commissioner to establish a truck route for travel into, through, or out of the territory under its jurisdiction, the commissioner shall investigate the matter. If the commissioner determines from investigation that the operation of trucks into, through, or out of the territory involves unusual hazards because of any or all of the following factors; load carried, type of truck used, or topographic or weather conditions, the commissioner may, by order, designate certain highways under the commissioner's jurisdiction as truck routes into, through, or out of such territory. When these highways have been marked as truck routes pursuant to the order, trucks traveling into, through, or out of the territory shall comply with the order.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.87.2">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 2.<span class="headnote">Seasonal load restriction.</span></h2>
          <p class="in">(a) Unless restricted as provided in subdivision 1, between the dates set by the commissioner of transportation each year, the weight on any single axle shall not exceed:</p>
          <p class="in">(1) five tons on an unpaved street or highway; or</p>
          <p class="in">(2) ten tons on a paved street or highway.</p>
          <p class="in">(b) The gross weight on consecutive axles on an unpaved street or highway shall not exceed the gross weight allowed in sections <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.823">169.823</a> to <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.829">169.829</a> multiplied by a factor of five divided by nine. This reduction shall not apply to the gross vehicle weight.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.87.3">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 3.<span class="headnote">School bus and Head Start bus.</span></h2>
          <p>Weight restrictions imposed pursuant to subdivisions 1 and 2 do not apply to a school bus or Head Start bus transporting students, Head Start children, or Head Start parents when the gross weight on a single axle of the school bus or Head Start bus does not exceed 14,000 pounds; provided that, road authorities may restrict any highway under their jurisdiction to a lesser axle weight by written order to school boards and Head Start grantees 24 hours in advance of required compliance with such reduced axle weight.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.87.4">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 4.<span class="headnote">Vehicle transporting milk.</span></h2>
          <p> A weight restriction imposed under subdivision 1 by the commissioner of transportation or a local road authority, or imposed by subdivision 2, does not apply to a vehicle transporting milk from the point of production to the point of first processing if, at the time the weight restriction is exceeded, the vehicle is carrying milk loaded at only one point of production. This subdivision does not authorize a vehicle described in this subdivision to exceed a weight restriction of five tons per axle by more than two tons per axle.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.87.5">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 5.<span class="headnote">Utility vehicles.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) Weight restrictions imposed by the commissioner under subdivisions 1 and 2 do not apply to a two-axle or three-axle utility vehicle that does not exceed a weight of 20,000 pounds per single axle and 36,000 pounds gross vehicle weight for a two-axle vehicle or 48,000 pounds gross vehicle weight for a three-axle vehicle, if the vehicle is owned by:</p>
          <p>(1) a public utility as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/216B.02">216B.02</a>;</p>
          <p>(2) a municipality or municipal utility that operates the vehicle for its municipal electric, gas, or water system; or</p>
          <p>(3) a cooperative electric association organized under chapter 308A.</p>
          <p>(b) The exemption in this subdivision applies only when the vehicle is performing service restoration or other work necessary to prevent an imminent loss of service.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.87.6">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 6.<span class="headnote">Recycling, garbage, and waste collection vehicles.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) While a vehicle is engaged in the type of collection the vehicle was designed to perform, weight restrictions imposed under subdivisions 1 and 2 do not apply to:</p>
          <p>(1) a vehicle that does not exceed 20,000 pounds per single axle and is designed and used exclusively for recycling, while operating in a political subdivision that mandates curbside recycling pickup;</p>
          <p>(2) a vehicle that does not exceed 14,000 pounds per single axle and is used exclusively for recycling;</p>
          <p>(3) a vehicle that does not exceed 14,000 pounds per single axle and is designed and used exclusively for collecting mixed municipal solid waste, as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/115A.03#stat.115A.03.21">115A.03, subdivision 21</a>;</p>
          <p>(4) a portable toilet service vehicle that does not exceed 14,000 pounds per single axle or 26,000 pounds gross vehicle weight, and is designed and used exclusively for collecting liquid waste from portable toilets; or</p>
          <p>(5) a sewage septic tank truck while performing emergency pumping services as defined in section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.829#stat.169.829.5">169.829, subdivision 5</a>, that does not exceed 20,000 pounds per single axle and is designed and used exclusively to haul sewage from septic or holding tanks.</p>
          <p>(b) Notwithstanding section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.80#stat.169.80.1">169.80, subdivision 1</a>, the owner or operator of a vehicle that violates the weight restrictions imposed under subdivisions 1 and 2 is not subject to criminal penalties but is subject to a civil penalty for excess weight under section <a href="https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/169.871">169.871</a> if the vehicle meets the requirements under paragraph (a) and is engaged in the type of collection the vehicle was designed to perform.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="subd" id="stat.169.87.7">
          
          <h2 class="subd_no">Subd. 7.<span class="headnote">Cargo tank vehicles.</span></h2>
          <p>(a) Weight restrictions imposed by the commissioner under subdivisions 1 and 2 do not apply to cargo tank vehicles with two or three permanent axles when delivering propane for heating or dyed fuel oil on seasonally weight-restricted roads if the vehicle is loaded at no more than 50 percent capacity of the cargo tank.</p>
          <p>(b) To be exempt from weight restrictions under paragraph (a), a cargo tank vehicle used for propane must have an operating gauge on the cargo tank that shows the amount of propane as a percent of capacity of the cargo tank. Documentation of the capacity of the cargo tank must be available on the cargo tank or in the cab of the vehicle. For purposes of this subdivision, propane weighs 4.2 pounds per gallon.</p>
          <p>(c) To be exempt from weight restrictions under paragraph (a), a cargo tank vehicle used for dyed fuel oil must utilize the forward two tank compartments and must carry documentation of the empty weight of the cargo tank vehicle from a certified scale in the cab of the vehicle. For purposes of this subdivision, dyed fuel oil weighs seven pounds per gallon.</p>
          <p>(d) To the extent practicable, cargo tank vehicles that are exempt from weight restrictions under paragraph (a) shall complete deliveries on seasonally weight-restricted roads by 12:00 p.m. and before the last week of April.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="history" id="stat.169.87.history
